subject: updateSelectInput for selectInput lists with multiple=TRUE ?

messages.author: d6f0b6be0b4f04e7
messages.subject: updateSelectInput for selectInput lists with multiple=TRUE ?
parts:
Are there plans to have updateSelectInput work for selectInput lists which allow for multiple selections? This would be very useful for me - I have in an application with dynamically generated lists and I'd like the user to be able to select arbitrary collections of elements from the dynamically generated lists. It would look nicer
and use less space than the alternative of having groups of checkboxes dynamically generated.
 
Thanks for any info or help on this.
